author: IGN
description:
Crimson Desert features a massive open world that can be daunting to traverse on foot. To keep your exploration of Pywel from becoming overwhelming, you’ll want to unlock the fast travel system as early as possible. Whether you're tracking down Abyss Nexus locations hidden in the fog or solving the environmental puzzles of the Abyss Cressets, having a network of teleportation points is the key to mastering this gigantic map.

In this Crimson Desert guide, we show you exactly how to locate and activate your first travel points near the city of Hernand. We break down the essential early-game skills you’ll need from Chapters 1 and 2—including Force Palm, Nature’s Grasp, and Focus—to solve the trials required for certain unlocks. We also share a pro tip on using your lantern and Blinding Flash to spot tech-floored Nexus points from a distance. From the Lioncrest Watchtower to the Karin Quarry, here is how to get around Pywel with ease.

#IGN #Gaming

Just starting out in Death Stranding 2? Use the guides to help you get going properly!

author: IGN
description:
Pretty much every modern graphics card will be able to run Crimson Desert without any kind of upscaling. Of course, DLSS and FSR are both supported, which can make the game run even better without really impacting the visual quality of the game.
Even on the Xbox Ally X, which is significantly weaker than any of the desktop graphics cards we tested, Crimson Desert runs just fine. Of course, just because the game is optimized to run well on a wide swath of PCs doesn’t mean that it’s not also chock-full of bugs and other quirks. For more on that, check out our full review.
title: Crimson Desert Might Be The Most Well-Optimized PC Games In Years – PC Performance Review

Welcome back to Next-Gen Console Watch! This week Daemon, Max, and Ryan are joined by IGN's senior tech manager, Bo Moore, to discuss Nvidia's reveal of their controversial DLSS 5 update. The footage caused a stir on the internet as the tech clearly is doing more than just enhancing performance relative to resolution, with many accusing Nvidia of using the equivalent of "AI TikTok filters" on character models. We break down what we think the tech initially set out to do, and what this means for the PS5 and Xbox. Plus we have last week's poll results, and a new poll for you to vote on at IGN.com and Spotify.

#ign #gaming
title: DLSS 5: Are Faces Fixed or F*****? - Next-Gen Console Watch

author: IGN
description:
Crimson Desert reviews are in and the verdict is it’s a strange, often frustrating, sometimes brilliant beast. A lot of what makes it unique is precisely why many players are bouncing off it. But it’s good that Triple-A games can still take huge swings like this, and if its edges were filed away, argues our Jim Trinca, it just wouldn’t be Crimson Desert any more.

The official IGN Crimson Desert review score is still to be finalised but it seems fairly in line with the user reviews that are now coming in from Steam and Metacritic among other places, and the game still has lots of issues that mean it’s going to need a lot of patching down the road. Crimson Desert’s review scores have been disappointing for the publisher, Pearl Abyss, which has seen a massive dip in its stock price since its metacritic average was revealed. But should any of that matter to players craving a new Red Dead Redemption or Witcher game, when Crimson Desert is the next best thing right now?

#CrimsonDesert #PS
title: Crimson Desert's Standout Feature is That It's Crimson Desert

description:
Tired of seeing that "poor control" message and losing your prize catch? Fishing in Crimson Desert's vast world of Pywel is more than just a simple minigame—it's a test of patience and tension management that the game doesn't fully explain. Whether you are struggling with the basic rod from Hernand or trying to track down all 51 unique species, we break down the exact mechanics of the "tug-of-war" system so you can stop snapping lines and start filling your inventory.

This Crimson Desert guide covers everything from finding your first fishing rod at the Provisioner’s Shop to locating rare Sturgeon using the Knowledge menu and map markers. We also dive into the three-step process for reeling in fish successfully, including how to manage rod tension and when to use the reel. Plus, if you're looking to optimize your grind, we'll show you how to find the Fine Fishing Rod Blueprint from Grimrak’s Back Alley Shop to significantly reduce your wait times between bites.

Right after the prologue, you gain access to the town of Hernand, and with it, a bank ripe for the picking. In this guide, we’ll show you exactly how to pull off a successful heist, from securing the necessary tools to escaping with your pockets full of silver.
